items.source: When this TaskScheduler is set, it is used to reset a count of the number of messages sent from client to broker since the beginning of the current heartbeat period. This is then used to decide whether to send a heartbeat to the broker when ignoring a message with a non-broker destination prefix.

items.source:
Set the maximum interval, in milliseconds, at which the "system" relay session
expects, in the absence of any other data, to receive a heartbeat from the STOMP
broker.
items.translation: 设置“system"中继会话期望接收来自 STOMP 代理心跳的最大间隔（以毫秒为单位），在没有其他数据的情况下。

items.source:

in the absence of any other data being sent, send a heartbeat to the STOMP broker.
items.translation: 设置“system"中继会话在没有任何其他数据发送的情况下，向 STOMP 代理发送心跳的间隔（以毫秒为单位）。

items.source:
Some STOMP clients (for example, stomp-js) always send heartbeats at a fixed rate
but others (Spring STOMP client) do so only when no other messages are
sent.
items.translation: 某些 STOMP 客户端（例如，stomp-js）始终以固定速率发送心跳，而其他客户端（如 Spring STOMP 客户端）仅在未发送其他消息时才发送心跳。

Set a destination to broadcast messages to user destinations that remain

items.source:
Set a destination to broadcast the content of the local user registry to
and to listen for such broadcasts from other servers.
